name: docs-deployment-kubernetes-md-08
yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rift
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: rift
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: rift
          image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
